text:
kevin: Cutting RC for 1.12.0-rc1 now. Includes cherrypicks: #342, #347 (kv-warm), and #350 (timeout fix). Requesting QA + pin for promote window 09:00-11:00 PT.

devbot: Build started: artifact=ri-1.12.0-rc1-4250000000 sha=abc123
CI: running unit/integration suites.

maria: QA: running smoke and kv-warm test. I'll post results in 10m.

qa-liz: Saw flakiness on heavy kv-warm load in staging — p95 token latency spike. Repro steps: run `make kv-warm-load` with concurrency 200. Trying a config tweak.

kevin: OK hold on promo. Suggest pin to rc1 and fix timeout cherrypick revert if flaky. What do we need to mitigate?

ashley: We can toggle kv-warm to read-only on canary nodes and limit concurrency via autoscale policy for 30m. If flip, rollback is revert to base 1.11.3 and unpin. Thoughts?

oncall-sam: I'm +1 on the autoscale tweak for canary. If we see error budget drop >2%, execute rollback: `deploybot rollback --to 1.11.3 --reason kv-warm-regress`

devbot: Build succeeded: artifact=ri-1.12.0-rc1-4250000000 sha=abc123
Canary image pushed to staging.

maria: QA: smoke pass, kv-warm load after autoscale tweak looks stable for 5m — p95 within baseline. Approve the RC for promo window starting now. :white_check_mark: 

kevin: Requesting pin. @deploy-admin please pin artifact ri-1.12.0-rc1 for promo window 09:00-11:00 PT

devbot: Pin created: artifact=ri-1.12.0-rc1 pin_id=pin-7753
Note: pin enforces artifact for this promo window.

ashley: Release notes draft:
- Fix: reduce token timeout regression (#350)
- Improvement: kv-cache warmup ordering for faster cold starts (#347)
- Cherry-pick: security header fix (#342)

kevin: Final check: metrics hooks in place? tracing enabled for canary?

maria: Yes, tracing + token-level latency metrics enabled. We'll monitor p95, error-rate, and cost-per-token during canary.

kevin: OK pushing promote. Deploybot, promote to prod canary 5% -> 20% over 30m, respecting quiet window.

devbot: Promotion initiated: rollout_plan={canary:5->20, step:10, interval:10m}, artifact=ri-1.12.0-rc1
Promote command: `/deploybot promote --artifact ri-1.12.0-rc1 --strategy canary --steps 5,10 --interval 600`

oncall-sam: Watching channels eng-oncall and incidents for alerts. If CPU or error-rate spikes >1.5x baseline for 3m, rollback.

maria: Observing canary: no errors, p95 stable. Will post update at +20m.

kevin: Thanks team. I'll update release notes and send changelog to #release-notes channel. Save any post-promote followups here.
